title: Floating chat bubbles should support mini input and text-only remarks
body: Add a floating mini message box under Mana's avatar when chat bubbles are enabled, preserve normal wake behaviour when they are disabled, and let text-only backend/proactive remarks appear as chat bubbles with activity-aware linger timing.
interface: ChatBubblesForm supports text-only remark bubbles, and MiniMessageBoxForm sends/queues messages like the normal chat input.
why: Launcher/UI work is a separate class of self-work task from Node backend fixes.
